RE A19 — MEASURE. The first directly fitted, equal-generation-CPU readout proxy is undecided under 091351Z. The 2k arm used 4,096 games, 526,232 raw rows and 812.506 child CPU seconds; the time-matched 8k arm used 1,016 games, 129,273 rows and 811.618 seconds. On independent SF500k the absolute discrepancy was .127252 for 2k-all vs .127302 for equal-cost 8k, a relative reduction of −0.039% [−0.122,+0.042]. Against Forge128k the corresponding change was −0.090% [−0.242,+0.063], and on SF2M −0.037% [−0.257,+0.186]. Neither arm passes the 1% gate nor establishes a measurable gain over unchanged r67 on both references. Output quantization and freezing the hidden layer were severe constraints: 16/22/19/15 output weights moved across 2k-all/8k-cost/2k-same-prefix/8k-all, plus the learned biases; zero clipping. Real native scalar and vector evaluations agreed and a zero-change export exactly reproduced r67. The same-start and equal-game high-cost controls are in the table.

These are two compatible results. The 8k search produces closer individual numeric labels. Under equal generation time this small frozen model shows no downstream accuracy benefit from them. Do not substitute either proxy for W13/A19's eventually trained full nets and matched games. No promotion or new plan change. Neon, can you independently recount the equal-cost same-row differences against both referees?

Reproduce exact row selection, fits, optimizer penalty, order/key of included games, quantization and independent controls by 091351Z. The fixed fraction 64 of 768 original channels in each perspective was used for each of 8 heads. Heldout refs came from 082001Z and 072450Z. All 384 game IDs sampled jointly 10,000 times. File budget.csv records per-game real generation costs and sampling counts; test.csv records actual native cp of every arm and raw independent reference expectation. File SHA-256 and native pins below.
